name: Integration qualification
implementation_gate: hint wiring at Entity config, producer, strict durable PUT; preserve conditional semantics
weakening_outcome: no layout change or unmatched path blocks combined claims

name: Agent workload characterization
weakening_outcome: low sharing or large mutations weaken workload premise

name: Locality and reuse
primary_metrics: Jaccard; weighted overlap; reuse distance; group-page reuse
implementation_gate: stable baseline identities and access keys
weakening_outcome: name locality absent or no cross-task page reuse

name: Workspace provisioning
baseline_controls: B1 B2 B3 B4 B5 B8; matched D0/D1
primary_metrics: ready latency; first tool; materialized metadata; bytes
implementation_gate: matched runtime; actual remote durability if compared
weakening_outcome: local overlay or lazy lower equal/better; startup scales with baseline

name: Mutation and churn
baseline_controls: same-path materialized lower; local supported contracts
primary_metrics: private bytes; tombstones; durable latency; retained objects
implementation_gate: fresh-only lifecycle/cleanup extension before repeated reclaim
weakening_outcome: cost approaches replication or cleanup grows unbounded

name: Packed access layout
primary_metrics: lower-KV calls; object counts; bytes; P50/P99
implementation_gate: lower adapters; directory capacity; separate upper/control counters
weakening_outcome: index/overfetch cost removes benefit or lower-KV fallback persists

name: Cache and cold state
intervention: index/meta/data warm states; supported cache sweeps
baseline_controls: equal memory and explicit server cache state
primary_metrics: miss rate; remote bytes; cold and warm latency
implementation_gate: readonly Packed rejects payload cache; new adapter required for that sweep

name: Snapshot construction amortization
primary_metrics: CPU-seconds; bytes; peak RAM; separate makespan
implementation_gate: consistent source capture and validated publication
weakening_outcome: break-even not reached in observed reuse lifetime

name: (B,q) physical mechanism
intervention: B fixed/default/auto; eligible q-selector; range alignment
baseline_controls: content-equivalent new object sets; same d/p
primary_metrics: persisted (B,q); data/parity pread bytes; EC/checksum CPU
implementation_gate: effective layout audit; identical persisted (B,q) is no-treatment; physical counters
weakening_outcome: q gate leaves layout unchanged or extra work offsets reads

name: Client and layout causality
baseline_controls: same objects within each persisted layout
implementation_gate: separate policy controls; retain upper integrity; new objects for q variants
weakening_outcome: gain is entirely caching/coalescing or upper still fetches whole object

name: Write and repair trade-off
implementation_gate: durability markers; q-aware repair and corruption validation

name: Composition
intervention: legal D/P/G factors under one runtime
baseline_controls: matched controls and complete system baselines
implementation_gate: same-path adapters and E00; no invented invalid cells
weakening_outcome: no interaction or no independent G benefit

name: Deterministic replay
primary_metrics: task time; critical path; tree/output verification
implementation_gate: initial state, path/handle mapping, payload and ordering
weakening_outcome: trace cannot replay or improvements vanish with fixed work

name: Live multi-agent execution
baseline_controls: B5 B8 full system; B3/B4 compatible subset
implementation_gate: AX/DSH mount proof; model and budget freeze; grading isolation
weakening_outcome: inference dominates or quality/failure changes apparent speed

name: Semantics and isolation
primary_metrics: mismatches; stale bytes; cross-view visibility; errors
implementation_gate: explicit support matrix and operation oracle

name: Failure and compatibility
baseline_controls: old/new persisted layouts and fail-closed oracle
primary_metrics: legal state; detection; recovery time; garbage
implementation_gate: reopen/takeover extension before runtime recovery claims
weakening_outcome: incomplete object published; integrity bypass; unsafe GC

name: Long-run bounds and interference
baseline_controls: steady state and isolated maintenance phases
primary_metrics: P99 windows; RSS; owners; pending uploads; GC lag
implementation_gate: actual lifecycle/GC support and owner/dir limits
